content:
Day One: Arrive in Tokyo at Narita Airport. Take the train to thy lodging in Shinjuku. Visit the Meiji Shrine and stroll through Yoyogi Park. Dine on sushi at a local izakaya. End the day with a quiet walk beneath the neon lights.  
Day Two: Journey to Kyoto via the shinkansen. Explore the Fushimi Inari shrine with its myriad torii gates. Wander the historic Gion district and spy a geisha hurrying to her engagement. Partake in tea ceremony at a traditional machiya house.
